title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1985-03-25
source: 2 source matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:084410) Pitch fix of shnid 15403 Original SRC: MSC>Cass.>DAT>CDR>SHN; Edit: SHN > WAV > repitch and patch in Cool Edit Pro > FLAC and Audience (shnid:23222) Schoeps CMC441s (90deg, 17cm) > Oade M118 > Oade mod SONY PCM-F1 Master PCM > DAW (via SEKD Prodif) > Wav > cdwav > Flac Recorded by the Oade Brothers

ai_review.summary: Crisp matrix recording captures an unforgettable Sugaree and a smoking Help‑Slip‑Frank sequence, though the closing with Day Job feels odd.
ai_review.review: The Dusborne matrix delivers crystal‑clear sound that lets every nuance of the 1985 show shine – from the “best Sugaree ever” to the flawless Help > Slip > Franklin’s medley. Reviewers rave about the clean mix and the removal of a distracting high‑end whistle, but a few are puzzled by the decision to end the set with Day Job.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews praise both performance and sound quality; recording is described as crisp/excellent, show highlighted by standout songs, yielding a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with no high‑end whistle artifacts; clear balance between board and audience ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, energetic flow through the first and second sets with superb transitions; ending choice (Day Job) leaves some listeners uneasy.
